brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Stacked full hex bases: piece:0,0,0;full at level 0 and piece:0,0,1;full at level 1 (with snap:0,0,0;full). Provides 2 levels (z=160mm total). Supported by joint bolts at both levels.
Two drawers installed on half bases: drawer:0#0,1#cut at level 0 and drawer:1#0,1#cut at level 1, each on piece:0,1,0;half-n and piece:0,1,1;half-n respectively, offering enclosed storage per level.

finish.summary: Built a compact 2-level tower (0,0 stacked full cells) with two drawers mounted on half-n extensions at q=0,r=1 levels 0 and 1. Joint bolts secure horizontal joints, meshClash clear and no errors.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
